keengamer.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this unlocks automatically — there is no separate task. Work through the roadmap stages in order and it pops last, after A Long Road.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing — the first mission of the game. It unlocks as the story starts; nothing to prepare.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Play through the opening chapter; the trophy pops at its end. Before you leave Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation (see Positive Mental Attitude) — it is the one thing in the game that can be missed.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Keep playing the story; both Jason and Lucia are playable from this chapter on, which opens most of the list.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. A story trophy — it pops at the end of the chapter.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. A story trophy. The optional mission “That’s Where The Money Is…” in this chapter unlocks the bank vaults — do it when it appears, since vaults feed both Maximum Withdrawal and the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. Keep a manual save from just before it — there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so a save is your only way back.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks as you play through the story.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. A story trophy.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child’s Play. A story trophy.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. A story trophy.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. A story trophy.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. A story trophy.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. After the story, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion to see the checklist — earlier progress already counts. It asks for the story, 100 optional tasks, robberies (39 Gang Operations, 22 Bank Jobs, 7 Payday Loan Jobs, 8 bank vaults), collectibles (15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 flamingos, 15 of 18 meditations) and activities (30 of 40 races won, 42 shooting-range golds, 42 drone trials, 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 Bret target decks). Nothing on it is missable, and you can skip parts of most categories.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 unique stunts across Leonida; there are 397 in total and the 100% checklist wants 300. Stunts are the jumps, airtime and near-miss feats the game tracks — spread them across the map as you travel rather than grinding one spot.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once. Just sample everything — one fishing trip, one arcade game, one race, and so on — and it pops.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. The range is the one activity the 100% checklist demands in full (42 of 42), so practise it early; golds need clean, fast runs.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. The 100% checklist also wants all 42 Drone Time Trials finished, so clear each location’s race and its time trial while you’re there.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct races count; the 100% checklist wants 30 of 40 won. Take one-off race invitations when they appear — one guide notes a race against Yago should be done the moment it shows up.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges appear as you fish around Leonida; take Cal’s challenge when it’s offered.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — any one. The 100% checklist wants all four video games played, so try each while you’re at an arcade.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Stranger mission strands open across Leonida as the story progresses; follow Andy’s strand to its end.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Follow Kenton’s strand to its last mission.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow Billy’s strand to its end.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. There are more strands than the eight needed, so pick any eight and finish them.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Follow Randy’s strand to its end.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Follow Tyrone’s strand to its end.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations, as Jason and Lucia. Do the first one in Chapter 1: after the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia at Jason’s house in the morning; when she mentions meditating, follow her to the balcony and accept. That spot is gone after Chapter 1, so keep a manual save at the start of each chapter. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of the 18 spots; the trophy needs all 18.
trophies.missableReason: The only potentially missable trophy (PowerPyx, via KeenGamer and GTA Zone): the first meditation spot is Lucia’s balcony in Chapter 1 and it disappears after that chapter. There is no mission replay.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret’s Target Deck gives 15 hunting objectives (all 15 are on the 100% checklist); the trophy needs one unique animal hunted for him. Study animals with binoculars as you travel — the checklist wants 100 of 255 species studied.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards are found across Leonida; the 100% checklist wants 15 of the 18 sets, so keep collecting past the three.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations. Scan unfamiliar vehicles and landmarks with the app whenever you see something new — start early and it fills up naturally.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game’s side objectives; the 100% checklist wants 70 of 80, so keep clearing them and skip the 10 hardest.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build four stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight together until the heat drops. It can be done in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row with your partner while the wanted level stays up — plan a route through nearby shops and a fast getaway.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scan new vehicles with the WAiNK app as you find them; the 100% checklist wants 200 base-model vehicles of 277.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus in a firefight with a group of enemies close together and drop five before it ends.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — steal a departing passenger aircraft from Vice City International Airport. Wait at the airport for a plane taxiing to depart, board it and take off.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino military tank and use it in combat. Rhinos appear at military sites; steal one and fight with it.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — no alarms, no witnesses spotting you — and get out clean.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Vaults open up with the optional Chapter 4 mission “That’s Where The Money Is…”; there are 8 vaults and the 100% checklist wants all 8. Every vault run brings a 4-star wanted level, so have a fast bike ready for the escape.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Hit an armored truck on the road, take the cash and lose the heat.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Uncover the complete map by travelling everywhere — the map fills in as you go.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. Gang Operations are the 39 robberies on the 100% checklist; make sure at least one hit lands on each gang’s turf.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact trigger is still being confirmed by published guides — KeenGamer lists it as unconfirmed as of 19 Nov 2026. Head to Ocean Beach and look for a bar or cocktail spot with a view; check back for the confirmed trigger.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The exact method is still unconfirmed in published guides as of 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates’ bowling alley: steal the three key valuables there and escape.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal: maximize the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia. Train Strength with both characters until each maxes it.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse): perform 500 actions affecting your Criminal Profile. Your criminal actions feed the profile — keep playing the criminal side of the game and the count climbs.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time’s the charm. The unlock method is still unconfirmed in published guides as of 19 Nov 2026 — KeenGamer lists it as unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The unlock method is still unconfirmed in published guides as of 19 Nov 2026 — KeenGamer lists it as unconfirmed.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl ’em over with a melee drive-by. The precise method is still being confirmed in published guides as of 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Fence marked bills through your contacts until the total hits $250,000 — the same $250,000 is on the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Just shop — clothes, weapons, food, anything — until the total passes $100,000.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — all eight. Buy every purchasable garage as they become available.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register vehicles you own through the app until you hit ten.
trophies.name: On the Spot
